da_01.m_zh: 温暖、讲故事的开头，不着急；“大大的巴比伦城”带一点惊叹，最后一句轻轻的、很喜欢他
da_01.d_zh: 画面：睡前，你翻开一本大图画书，孩子靠在你身边。你用手指着书上蓝色的高城墙，小声说“看，好大的城”。
da_01.m_en: warm storyteller opening, unhurried; a little wonder on 'great city'; soft and fond on the last sentence
da_01.d_en: Picture: bedtime. You open a big picture book and a child leans on you. You point at the tall blue city wall and say, 'Look how big it is.'

da_02.m_zh: 大方、热情的王，很满意自己的好朋友；“我都放心”带着笑，最后一句说得很隆重
da_02.d_zh: 画面：你坐在宝座上，但以理站在你面前。你笑着把一只大手放在他肩膀上，让全王宫的人都听见你夸他。
da_02.m_en: a big, warm king, pleased with his friend; a laugh on 'anything'; grand on the last sentence
da_02.d_en: Picture: you sit on your throne and Daniel stands in front of you. You smile, put a big hand on his shoulder, and praise him so the whole palace can hear.

da_03.m_zh: 谦虚、平静，一位和气的大人；带一点微笑，最后半句放慢
da_03.d_zh: 画面：王刚刚当着大家的面夸了你。你微微低头行礼，说到“都是上帝给的”时，抬头看了一眼天。
da_03.m_en: humble and calm, a kind grown-up; a small smile; slower on the last phrase
da_03.d_en: Picture: the king has just praised you in front of everyone. You bow your head a little. On 'comes from God' you look up at the sky.

da_04.m_zh: 酸溜溜、嫉妒、有点耍赖；先重重“哼”一声，“找啊找”加快，最后一句气得直叫
da_04.d_zh: 画面：你抱着胳膊，跺着脚走到最前面，对着小朋友发牢骚。你翻遍了但以理的抽屉和账本，一点错都没找到，气坏了。
da_04.m_en: sulky, jealous, a bit whiny; a loud 'hmph' first; faster on 'looked and looked'; a cross wail at the end
da_04.d_en: Picture: arms folded, you stomp to the front and complain to the child. You looked in all of Daniel's books and papers and found nothing wrong. You are so cross!

da_05.m_zh: 狡猾，主意一点点冒出来所以越说越慢；偷偷笑一声，结尾小声又得意
da_05.d_zh: 画面：你正要走开，忽然停住，一根手指竖在嘴边。你想到了一个坏点子，眼睛一亮，捂着嘴偷笑。
da_05.m_en: sly, slowing down as the idea comes; a sneaky giggle; whispered and cheeky at the end
da_05.d_en: Picture: you are about to walk away, then you stop with one finger on your lips. A naughty idea comes. Your eyes light up and you giggle behind your hand.

da_06.m_zh: 油腔滑调、甜得发腻的奉承；“伟大的王”喊得很夸张，后面说得又快又急，“狮子坑”带一点坏坏的得意
da_06.d_zh: 画面：你对着王深深鞠躬，鼻子都快碰到地了，然后哗地展开一卷长长的法令，恨不得王马上点头。
da_06.m_en: oily, too-sweet flattery; big on 'great King'; then quick and pushy; a wicked little relish on 'lions'
da_06.d_en: Picture: you bow so low your nose nearly touches the floor. Then you unroll a long paper law and hope the king says yes right away.

da_07.m_zh: 被夸得飘飘然，有点爱面子，呵呵笑；“嗯”是在想，“盖章”又快又高兴
da_07.d_zh: 画面：大臣刚把你夸上了天。你摸摸胡子，心里美滋滋的，想了一秒钟，就举起戒指“啪”地盖下去。
da_07.m_en: flattered and a little vain, chuckling; a thinking 'hmm'; brisk and pleased on 'Seal it'
da_07.d_en: Picture: the official has just called you the greatest king. You stroke your beard and feel very pleased. You think for one second, then press your ring down. Stamp!

da_08.m_zh: 安静、佩服；“可他还是”后面停一小下，“一天三次”说得稳稳的、慢慢的
da_08.d_zh: 画面：你隔着街，看见但以理回到家，像每天一样推开那扇窗，在小毯子上跪下来。你小声告诉身边的孩子他有多勇敢。
da_08.m_en: quiet and admiring; a small pause after 'But'; steady and slow on 'three times a day'
da_08.d_en: Picture: from across the street you watch Daniel go home, open the same window as every day, and kneel on his little rug. You tell the child softly how brave he is.

da_09.m_zh: 真的在祷告，轻轻的、很近，不像讲道；平静、信靠，“可你是”前面吸一口气，“也帮助我们的王”说得很温柔
da_09.d_zh: 画面：你一个人跪在窗前，凉凉的风吹进来，远处是耶路撒冷的方向。你闭上眼睛，像跟最亲的爸爸小声说话。
da_09.m_en: a real prayer, soft and close, not preachy; calm and trusting; a breath before 'but You are'; gentle on 'help our king too'
da_09.d_en: Picture: you kneel alone at the open window. A cool wind comes in. Far away is Jerusalem. You close your eyes and talk quietly, like to a father you love.

da_10.m_zh: 开头用气声，幸灾乐祸；越说越响，变成坏坏的咯咯笑，最后又快又兴奋
da_10.d_zh: 画面：你踮着脚躲在棕榈树后面，探出半个脑袋，正好看见但以理跪着祷告。你高兴得差点跳起来，转身就要跑去告状。
da_10.m_en: a whisper at first, gleeful and nasty; rising to a little cackle; quick and excited at the end
da_10.d_en: Picture: you tiptoe behind a palm tree and peek out. There is Daniel on his knees, praying! You almost jump for joy, then turn to run to the king.

da_11.m_zh: 告状、得意洋洋，又快又尖
da_11.d_zh: 画面：你一路跑进王宫，气都没喘匀，伸出手指头指着但以理家的方向，像个抢着打小报告的同学。
da_11.m_en: tattling and triumphant; fast and shrill
da_11.d_en: Picture: you run all the way into the palace, still out of breath. You point toward Daniel's house, like a child who loves to tell on others.

da_12.m_zh: 先吓一跳，然后又急又乱；“不行不行”连着滚出来，后半句下了决心，可是心里害怕
da_12.d_zh: 画面：你正开开心心坐着，一听到“但以理”三个字，一下子站起来，脸都白了。你搓着手在屋里走来走去。
da_12.m_en: shocked, then upset and fumbling; 'no, no' tumbles out; determined but afraid on the last half
da_12.d_en: Picture: you are sitting happily. Then you hear the name 'Daniel' and jump up. Your face goes white. You walk up and down and rub your hands.

da_13.m_zh: 得意、像唱歌一样、假装很有礼貌；结尾那个“哦”要坏坏的
da_13.d_zh: 画面：王急得团团转，你却不慌不忙，笑眯眯地举起那卷盖了章的法令，在王眼前晃了晃。
da_13.m_en: smug, sing-song, mock-polite; a nasty little 'never' at the end
da_13.d_en: Picture: the king is walking in circles with worry. You are not in a hurry. You smile, hold up the law with his seal on it, and wave it in front of his eyes.

da_14.m_zh: 长长地叹气，真的后悔，快要哭了
da_14.d_zh: 画面：你一屁股坐回宝座，双手捂住脸。你盯着自己手上那枚盖章的戒指，恨不得把它摘下来扔掉。
da_14.m_en: a long groan of regret; real sorrow, almost tearful
da_14.d_en: Picture: you drop back onto your throne and hide your face in your hands. You look at the ring that sealed the law and wish you had never used it.

da_15.m_zh: 低低的、认真的，但是温柔，不要吓人
da_15.d_zh: 画面：太阳快下山了，天空是橙红色的。你看着但以理安安静静地走向石头坑，把孩子的小手握紧一点，轻轻地讲。
da_15.m_en: low and serious, but gentle; not scary
da_15.d_en: Picture: the sun is going down and the sky is orange. You watch Daniel walk calmly to the stone den. You hold the child's hand a little tighter and speak softly.

da_16.m_zh: 喉咙发紧，但充满盼望；叫“但以理”时声音卡一下，“一定会救你”说得坚定
da_16.d_zh: 画面：在狮子坑的洞口，你跟最好的朋友说再见。你抓着他的手不想放，眼睛红红的，可是你想让他听见你相信。
da_16.m_en: choked up but full of hope; a catch in the voice on 'Daniel'; firm and sure on 'He will save you'
da_16.d_en: Picture: at the door of the lions' den you say goodbye to your best friend. You hold his hand and do not want to let go. Your eyes are wet, but you want him to hear that you believe.

da_17.m_zh: 平安，反过来安慰王；安静却有力量，带一点微笑
da_17.d_zh: 画面：王在你面前快哭了。你一点都不慌，拍拍他的手，像大人安慰一个害怕的孩子，然后转身走进坑里。
da_17.m_en: peaceful, comforting the king; quiet strength, a small smile
da_17.d_en: Picture: the king is almost crying in front of you. You are not afraid. You pat his hand, like a grown-up with a scared child, then turn and walk into the den.

da_18.m_zh: 压低声音、有点紧张，“慢慢走过来”拖慢；到“没有害怕”转成平静、温暖
da_18.d_zh: 画面：你趴在洞口往下看，黑黑的坑里有几双亮亮的眼睛，一步一步靠近。然后你看见但以理安安稳稳地跪了下来。
da_18.m_en: hushed and suspenseful, slow on 'crept closer'; then calm and warm on 'wasn't afraid'
da_18.d_en: Picture: you look down into the dark den. Shiny eyes come closer, step by step. Then you see Daniel kneel down, calm and still.

da_19.m_zh: 光出现时又慢又惊叹；从“大哈欠”开始越讲越想笑，到“呼噜呼噜”最好玩、最开心
da_19.d_zh: 画面：黑黑的坑一下子亮得像白天。那只最大的狮子张开大嘴——原来只是打哈欠！它趴在但以理脚边，像你家的猫一样打呼噜。
da_19.m_en: slow and awed on the light, then a giggle that grows from 'big yawn' to 'purred'; playful and happy
da_19.d_en: Picture: the dark den is suddenly bright like day. The biggest lion opens its mouth wide... but it is only a yawn! It lies down by Daniel's feet and purrs like your cat at home.

da_20.m_zh: 有点好笑又有点可怜，像在讲一个太爱操心的大人
da_20.d_zh: 画面：半夜的王宫，桌上的饭菜一口没动，都凉了。王穿着睡袍，在火把下面走过来、走过去。
da_20.m_en: a little funny-sad, like telling about a grown-up who worries too much
da_20.d_en: Picture: midnight in the palace. The dinner on the table is cold and nobody has touched it. The king walks up and down in his night robe by the torch.

da_21.m_zh: 坐立不安、发愁，一声又累又长的叹气；第二个“睡不着”带点好笑的哼唧
da_21.d_zh: 画面：你躺下又坐起来，把枕头翻了第十遍。窗外还是黑的，你满脑子都是坑里的但以理。
da_21.m_en: restless and fretting, a big tired sigh; a comic whimper on the second 'can't sleep'
da_21.d_en: Picture: you lie down, then sit up again. You turn your pillow over for the tenth time. It is still dark outside and you can only think of Daniel in the den.

da_22.m_zh: 跑得上气不接下气，着急，朝坑里大声喊；问那一句时担心得声音都破了
da_22.d_zh: 画面：公鸡刚叫，你光着脚一路跑到狮子坑，趴在大石头上朝缝里喊。喊完你屏住呼吸，等里面有没有回答。
da_22.m_en: out of breath from running, anxious, calling loudly into the den; the voice cracks on the question
da_22.d_en: Picture: the rooster has just crowed. You run to the den with no shoes on and call through the gap by the big stone. Then you hold your breath and wait for an answer.

da_23.m_zh: 高兴，从坑底往上喊，话里带着笑；响亮、明朗
da_23.d_zh: 画面：你在坑底抬起头，看见石头缝里透进来的晨光和王着急的脸。你一只手还放在狮子毛茸茸的背上，朝上面挥手。
da_23.m_en: joyful, calling up from the den with a happy laugh in it; strong and bright
da_23.d_en: Picture: you look up from the bottom of the den. Morning light comes through the gap and you see the king's worried face. One hand is still on a lion's soft back. You wave up at him.

da_24.m_zh: 大大地松了一口气，边笑边喊，高兴得指挥大家；“快，快”说得很急
da_24.d_zh: 画面：你听见但以理的声音，高兴得原地蹦了一下，转身朝卫兵们直挥手，自己也伸手去推那块大石头。
da_24.m_en: huge relief, laughing, bossy-happy; quick on 'quick, quick'
da_24.d_en: Picture: you hear Daniel's voice and jump for joy. You wave at the guards to hurry, and you push the big stone with your own hands too.

da_25.m_zh: 高兴，还有一点不敢相信；最后一句放慢、放暖
da_25.d_zh: 画面：石头滚开了，但以理笑着走进阳光里，衣服上连一道小口子都没有。王跑上去一把抱住了他。
da_25.m_en: glad and a little amazed; slow and warm on the last sentence
da_25.d_en: Picture: the stone rolls away. Daniel walks out into the sunshine with a smile. There is not even a small tear in his clothes. The king runs to hug him.

da_26.m_zh: 被发现了，紧张、含含糊糊，假装没事；声音越来越小
da_26.d_zh: 画面：大家都在欢呼，你踮着脚尖贴着墙根往外溜。忽然所有人都转过头来看着你，你只好挤出一个尴尬的笑。
da_26.m_en: caught out, nervous, mumbling, trying to sound casual; trails off
da_26.d_en: Picture: everyone is cheering. You tiptoe along the wall to get away. Then all the heads turn to look at you, and you make a very awkward smile.

da_27.m_zh: 又高又尖的卡通式尖叫，好笑的那种害怕；边跑边喊，声音越来越远
da_27.d_zh: 画面：一只狮子从坑口探出头，冲你“嗷”了一声。你吓得帽子都飞了，拔腿就跑，一路跑出图画书的边。
da_27.m_en: a high, comic shriek, cartoon-style; it fades away as he runs
da_27.d_en: Picture: a lion puts its head out of the den and roars at you. Your hat flies off. You run and run, right off the edge of the page.

da_28.m_zh: 王的大宣告，但是是欢喜的，不凶；张开双臂，声音洪亮、响当当
da_28.d_zh: 画面：明亮的早晨，你一只手搂着但以理，站在王宫高高的台阶上。下面站满了全国的人，你要让最后一排也听得见。
da_28.m_en: a king's big proclamation, joyful, not stern; arms open; strong and ringing
da_28.d_en: Picture: a bright morning. You stand at the top of the palace steps with one arm around Daniel. The whole kingdom is below, and you want the people at the very back to hear you.

da_29.m_zh: 温暖的结尾，直接对着小朋友说；最后一句带着笑
da_29.d_zh: 画面：你合上图画书，蹲下来看着孩子的眼睛。讲到“他一直在听”时，轻轻点一下孩子的小鼻子。
da_29.m_en: a warm ending, speaking right to the child; a smile on the last sentence
da_29.d_en: Picture: you close the picture book and bend down to look in the child's eyes. On 'He's always listening' you tap the child gently on the nose.
